title: Inline rename shows the old name after a successful save
why: The save succeeds and the toast confirms the new name. The row is wrong only because a page refresh reached the server before the save did.
finding: `save()` fires the PATCH without awaiting it, then calls `router.refresh()`. The refetch started 3ms after the PATCH and came back first; the PATCH took 1025ms, so the refreshed row still had the old name.
actual: After clicking Save, the inline editor closes and the toast "Renamed to “Website Refresh Round Trip”" appears, but the row's name link/text continues to show the old name "Website Refresh QA Renamed" — the row is never updated with the committed name.
expected: After clicking Save in the inline rename form, the renamed project's row in the projects table should be refreshed to display the newly saved name "Website Refresh Round Trip" (matching the PATCH response body and the confirmation toast).

chronology.text: On the Projects dashboard, the inline rename editor for the first row is open with the input filled with the new name "Website Refresh Round Trip" and Save/Cancel buttons visible; the user clicks the row's Save control to commit the rename.

chronology.text: After Save is clicked, the app shows the toast "Renamed to 'Website Refresh Round Trip'" but the first row's Name column still displays the old name "Website Refresh QA Renamed" — the row was not refreshed with the committed name.

reproduce.text: Click the ✎ rename affordance on any one project row in the projects table to open that row's inline rename editor
Clear the inline 'Project name' field in the renaming row
Type the project's new name into the inline 'Project name' field
Click the row's Save control to commit the rename

rootCause.text: In components/ProjectsTable.tsx, ProjectName.save() fires the PATCH fetch without awaiting it, then immediately calls router.refresh() and onRenamed(name) on the same tick. Because router.refresh() triggers a concurrent RSC refetch (GET /projects?_rsc=1qm1g initiated at 109972ms, just 3ms after the PATCH started at 109969ms) while the PATCH is still in flight (it completes 1025ms later at 110992ms), the refetched payload still contains the pre-rename project name, so the table row continues rendering "Website Refresh QA Renamed". The toast "Renamed to “Website Refresh Round Trip”" is shown optimistically via onRenamed(name) using the draft name, masking that the row was never updated with the committed name.
